lake-abilene.notice: Texas Parks and Wildlife Department's Abilene State Park alert states that Lake Abilene boat ramps are closed, kayak rentals are unavailable, and fishing and swimming are not allowed due to low water. This is a lake-specific restriction, not a closure of every activity at Abilene State Park.

fort-parker-state-park-lake.notice: TPWD lists the Navasota River boat ramp closed October 19, 2026 through January 10, 2027 for road work. Both park fishing piers remain closed. The separate Fort Parker Lake ramp has had low-water restrictions; confirm its current status with the park before launching. Do not treat the two ramps as interchangeable or assume the river ramp reopens automatically on January 11; check the current park alert before travel.
